subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should assistant-media query-token auth be removed now as a secure fail-closed change, or should this shipped fallback get a deprecation or opt-in transition first?
rationale: The fallback is a real credential-in-URL risk, but v2026.6.11 ships it and a related hardening PR notes compatibility concerns, so automation cannot choose the upgrade window for maintainers.

options.title: Refresh tests and accept removal
options.body: Update the current-main tests to use bearer/mediaTicket auth, then land the PR if maintainers accept breaking query-token media URLs.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a documented deprecation window or explicit compatibility mode before removing query-token assistant-media auth.

options.title: Fold into broader hardening
options.body: Pause this focused PR if maintainers want the removal coordinated with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75076.

recommendation.title: Refresh tests and accept removal
recommendation.body: Update the current-main tests to use bearer/mediaTicket auth, then land the PR if maintainers accept breaking query-token media URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: The scoped mediaTicket replacement path and docs came from this area contributor, making them the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
